description: IMPORTANT: results are previews (up to 5 messages per thread, from this page only). Never answer questions about the latest or unread email from previews alone; call get_thread to read relevant threads in full. Lists email threads in the Naver Mail account matching a query, newest first, with pagination. Each thread has its id, messageCount (messages from this page) and messages with id, sender, recipients, date, labelIds, subject and snippet. Use it to find thread ids before reading full threads or acting on emails.

includeTrash.description: Include messages in Trash. Default false.

pageSize.description: Max messages to return (grouped into threads). Default 20, max 50.

query.description: Gmail search syntax, converted to IMAP for Naver Mail. Supported: from:, to:, cc:, bcc:, subject:, "exact phrase", bare keywords, after:YYYY/MM/DD (inclusive), before:YYYY/MM/DD (exclusive), newer_than:/older_than: (e.g. 7d, 2m, 1y), is:unread, is:read, is:starred, has:attachment, filename:, larger:/smaller: (e.g. 5M), in:inbox|sent|trash|spam|draft|anywhere, label:<folder name>, OR, { }, -exclude, ( ). Bare keywords match subject, sender or body. has:attachment/filename: check message structure of the newest 3000 messages per folder (add a date filter for older mail). Default scope: all folders except trash, spam and drafts. Unsupported operators (category:, AROUND …) are ignored and reported in warnings. Prefer short keyword queries.

view.description: THREAD_VIEW_MINIMAL (default) includes subject and snippet; THREAD_VIEW_METADATA_ONLY excludes them.

name: search_threads
